localizedSummaries.zh-TW: 切爾西主場2比0擊敗曼聯，控球率、射門與射正數均領先對手。
localizedSummaries.en: Chelsea defeated Manchester United 2-0 at home, leading in possession, shots, and shots on target.

localizedBodies.zh-CN: 切尔西以58.6%的控球率占据主动，全场18次射门、9次射正，均高于曼联的12次射门和5次射正。传球方面，切尔西531次、成功率88.7%，曼联370次、成功率77.8%；关键传球14比9。犯规与牌面数据上，曼联20次犯规、4张黄牌和1张红牌，切尔西为8次犯规、1张黄牌。数据来源：PitchAPI match statistics。
localizedBodies.zh-TW: 切爾西以58.6%的控球率佔據主動，全場18次射門、9次射正，均高於曼聯的12次射門和5次射正。傳球方面，切爾西531次、成功率88.7%，曼聯370次、成功率77.8%；關鍵傳球14比9。犯規與牌面數據上，曼聯20次犯規、4張黃牌和1張紅牌，切爾西為8次犯規、1張黃牌。數據來源：PitchAPI match statistics。
localizedBodies.en: Chelsea dominated with 58.6% possession, recording 18 shots and 9 on target, both higher than Manchester United's 12 shots and 5 on target. In passing, Chelsea made 531 passes with an 88.7% success rate, while Manchester United had 370 passes with a 77.8% success rate; key passes were 14 to 9. In fouls and cards, Manchester United committed 20 fouls, received 4 yellow cards and 1 red card, while Chelsea had 8 fouls and 1 yellow card. Data source: PitchAPI match statistics.
